blockingIssues.description: The new regression only exercises the signed-out shell while the shared Linear fixture still keeps `audit: null`, so it never renders the populated delivery/closeout audit cards from the original `/account` validation flow and leaves the real audited path unguarded.

appliedUpdates.description: Documented the approved `<tmp-home>` and `<tmp-daemon-sock>` placeholders for committed mission-artifact sanitization evidence.
Documented that account-shell regressions touching the Linear section should reference the validated routed `/account` audit state instead of relying only on `audit: null` fixtures.
